* '''PC-E1''' ([[Alien Rabble (Errata)]]): Card image published 1 June 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/alienrabble.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/alienrabble.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “This card has your Rep's species. When deployed, may retrieve a Rep or place a Rep stacked on your Objective in Used Pile. Once per turn, if No Love For The Empire on table and you just retrieved Force, may place top card of Used Pile on Force Pile.” The PC published pixel-identical copies of this image on 5 July 2022 (file format change only; no visible change). '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image only: the PC re-rendered the Virtual Set 16 card images (the side credit and copyright lines and the typesetting of the game text changed; on some cards icons or the set-icon position also changed); the game text words are the same. A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
